verdict.rationale: Twilio's own docs show it can record calls and has an API for setting account-wide default call recording settings. A community user also reports using it for voicemail-to-webhook with transcription. However, nothing in the pack covers jurisdiction-specific consent handling or how recordings are searched and retrieved later. Missing for 10: consent/announcement handling by jurisdiction, recording storage/search/retrieval documentation, independent corroboration of call recording.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can record calls with the consent handling my jurisdictions require and find the recordings later

citations.quote: respond to incoming phone calls, gather user input, record calls, and take payments without needing a person to answer the phone
The Voice Recording Account Default Configuration is a new API that enables customers to set and manage default call recording settings for your account.
